content:
Amazon has a whole boatload of 4K and Blu-ray movies and TV shows on sale for Black Friday. Among the deep discounts is a Christmas movie promotion that just went live. Right now, you can get some of the biggest classic holiday movies on sale for $9.99 apiece. These are 4K movies you can watch on an annual basis to get in the holiday spirit. They’re 10 bucks each. That’s a heck of a deal.

4K Christmas Movies for $9.99

I’m not kidding when I say the movies on here represent some of the best and most classic Christmas movies ever put on film. There’s A Christmas Story, the wry 1983 movie that’s so steeped in 1940s nostalgia, it feels like a cozy blanket even if you were born well after that bygone era.

Then there’s the late-‘80s classic, National Lampoon’s Christmas Vacation. I’ve watched that one almost every year of my entire life. It’s still funny! A newer entry in the genre is Illumination's delightfully animated film Dr. Seuss’ The Grinch. Elf is another winner, thanks to Will Ferrell’s portrayal of the guileless titular character.

Animated classics that used to (and maybe still do?) air each year on broadcast channels are also in the sale, with Frosty the Snowman, Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer, and A Charlie Brown Christmas. And then there's the most heartwarming Christmas movie of them all: Gremlins.

Any way you slice it, $9.99 for these movies is a steal, especially if you live in a household with annual viewings of your favorites. Would I love to see A Muppet’s Christmas Carol in here? Yes, I would. Do I begrudge Amazon for not including it? Yes, I kind of do (even though it's somehow not available in 4K yet?). To get over it, I guess I need to watch some of these heartwarming holiday films, with their themes of Yuletide self-improvement.

You’ll find a lot more Black Friday coverage over on IGN Deals, and you can see all the biggest upcoming 4K and Blu-ray home releases here.
